title: truth.json — course/data/truth.json (the authoritative fact layer; on-screen text comes from here)

source.description: The authoritative source name (book, standard, course, expert).

facts.description: id -> fact. ids are short codes (KN-1, STEP-3, RULE-2). Used by concept/quote beats and verified by verify_facts.

title.description: Exact title shown on the concept card.

statement.description: A REAL, verbatim, quotable sentence. quote beats must be a substring of this.

section.description: Page/section/chapter where it appears (shown as the citation).
